macros.name: DeclareNonlocalMacros
macros.doc: This command will run \DeclareNonlocalMacro on each argument.

macros.name: locallydefine
macros.doc: Execute ⟨processing⟩ inside of a group, and make the definition of \macro persist after the group ends.

macros.name: makecounterslocal
macros.doc: The macro \makecounterslocal redefines the LaTeX hcounter i macros so that their changes are local, instead of global.

macros.name: manyaftergroup
macros.doc: The macro \manyaftergroup works by parsing it’s argument one token at a time, and applying \aftergroup to each argument.

macros.name: pushvalue
macros.doc: The argument {⟨macro⟩} is backed up by \pushvalue, and the most recently backed up value is restored by \popvalue.

macros.name: pushvalues
macros.doc: Every macro in the passed argument is backed up by \pushvalues, and the most recently backed up values are restored by \popvalues.

macros.name: restorevalues
macros.doc: Every token in the passed argument is backed up by \savevalues, and the most recently backed up values are restored by \restorevalues.

macros.name: savevalues
macros.doc: Every token in the passed argument is backed up by \savevalues, and the most recently backed up values are restored by \restorevalues.

macros.name: unignoreglobal
macros.doc: The macro \unignoreglobal undoes the changes made by the last \ignoreglobal.
